name: agent-ship-kit
description: Ship with agents: pass/fail bars before delegating, independent cross-model review, commit/branch/PR conventions, stacked PRs, and a pre-push rule-check gate.

orchestration_card.title: Kickoff card
orchestration_card.description: Inject a short delegation kickoff card on every non-trivial prompt.

context_guard.title: Context guard
context_guard.description: Warn once when context crosses the handoff and hard-stop thresholds.

context_handoff_k.title: Handoff threshold (k tokens)
context_handoff_k.description: Context size that triggers the handoff warning.

context_hard_k.title: Hard-stop threshold (k tokens)
context_hard_k.description: Context size that triggers the hard-stop warning.

lsp_first.title: LSP-first search
lsp_first.description: Block bare camelCase/PascalCase grep over source files and point to the LSP tool. Enable only if you have an LSP plugin installed.
